title: ERG a/b-wave bar (individual points)

hline.note: Dashed horizontal reference line at this amplitude, in the displayed unit. Blank = none.

hline_label.note: Optional caption for the horizontal reference line.

vline.note: Dashed VERTICAL divider at this bar position — the bars sit at 0, 1, 2, … left to right, so 1.5 falls between the 2nd and 3rd. Separates condition blocks; blank = none.

vline_label.note: Optional caption for the vertical divider.

background: Peak a-wave or b-wave amplitude at one flash intensity per condition, measured straight from the dropped recording's traces (device markers preferred when present). The a-wave (pre-stimulus baseline → trough) and b-wave (a-trough → peak) follow the ISCEV definitions; the cone-vs-rod search windows are anchored to published mouse ERG timing.

catalog.summary: Peak a-wave or b-wave at one flash intensity per condition (scotopic or photopic) — bar of the group mean ± SEM with every eye overlaid as an individual point (the reviewer ask for quantitative graphs). Runs straight off the dropped recording: reads the device markers when present, else measures the peak from the same traces the grid draws, at the intensity you pick. Condition colours + order match the trace grid; attaches a per-condition n / mean / SEM table.
